inventory.title: 仓储管理 · 腾出空间
Storage · free space
inventory.purpose: 仓满时，可主动丢弃不需要的可用物资，为生产交付或远征返程腾出空间。
When stores are full, discard unwanted available resources to make room for deliveries or an expedition’s return.
inventory.reservedHint: 只能丢弃可用物资。生产、突破等已预留的物资不在可丢弃数量内。
Only available resources can be discarded. Materials reserved for production, breakthroughs or other commitments are excluded.
inventory.discardTitle: Choose a resource and quantity to discard
inventory.quantityHint: 请输入正整数，最多 {available}；不会自动填入或取整。
Enter a positive whole number, up to {available}. No amount is filled in or rounded automatically.
inventory.invalid: 数量须为大于 0 且不超过当前可用库存的整数。
The quantity must be a positive whole number no greater than the available stock.
inventory.confirm: 丢弃 {quantity} 份{name}？这些物资将立即移出库存，无法撤销。
Discard {quantity} {name}? These resources will leave your stores immediately and cannot be recovered.
inventory.confirmReserved: 丢弃后现有库存为 {remaining}；其中已预留的 {reserved} 份保持不变。
Held stock will be {remaining}; the {reserved} reserved units will remain unchanged.
inventory.stale: 核对期间库存已改变。这次确认已失效，请重新检查数量。
Stock changed during your review. This confirmation has expired; review the quantity again.
inventory.readOnly: 当前存档只读，无法丢弃物资。
This campaign is read-only; resources cannot be discarded.
inventory.busy: 正在处理存档，请稍候再操作。
A save operation is in progress. Please wait.
inventory.pending: 丢弃指令已接受，正在等待最新库存。
Discard accepted; waiting for the updated stock.
inventory.applied: 已丢弃 {quantity} 份{name}。请保存战役，以便下次载入保留此变化。
Discarded {quantity} {name}. Save the campaign to keep this change for a later load.
inventory.rejected: 未能执行丢弃。请检查当前库存和操作权限，再重新核对。
The discard was not accepted. Check current stock and access, then review again.
inventory.uncertain: 尚无法确认操作结果。请等待库存更新；不要重复提交。
The outcome could not be confirmed. Wait for the stock update before submitting again.
inventory.returnHint: 远征返程结算被满仓阻挡。以下是本次实际奖励和剩余补给需要腾出的空间：
The expedition’s return is blocked by full stores. Its actual rewards and unused supplies need this much space:
inventory.returnRetry: 填入数量不会立即丢弃，仍须核对并确认。腾出足够空间后，回到远征页面再次确认返程结算。
Using a quantity only fills the input; review and confirmation are still required. After freeing enough space, retry the return settlement from the Expedition view.
